products.name: HPE ProLiant DL380 Gen11
products.description: High-performance 2U rack server powered by 4th-generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors, supporting up to 8TB of DDR5 RAM and mission-critical workloads including enterprise databases, virtualization, and advanced analytics.
products.roi_pitch: Reduces total cost of ownership (TCO) by up to 30% by consolidating multiple legacy servers onto a single high-performance platform, lowering energy consumption and rack space requirements.
products.pain_solved: Eliminates dependency on obsolete infrastructure that drives high maintenance costs, unplanned downtime, and operational bottlenecks limiting business agility.

products.name: HPE Alletra Storage MP
products.description: AI-powered intelligent all-flash storage platform with automated performance optimization and predictive analytics. Supports NVMe, scales non-disruptively, and integrates seamlessly with multicloud and hybrid environments for zero-compromise data services.
products.roi_pitch: Delivers up to 4x better performance versus traditional storage with up to 67% reduction in physical footprint and energy consumption, achieving positive ROI in under 12 months.
products.pain_solved: Resolves capacity shortfalls, slow data access, and escalating maintenance costs of aging storage systems that restrict digital transformation initiatives.

products.name: HPE GreenLake Cloud Services
products.description: As-a-service cloud platform that delivers on-demand compute, storage, and networking resources under a pay-per-use model. Fully compatible with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud for consistent multicloud and hybrid strategies managed from a single control plane.
products.roi_pitch: As-a-service model that eliminates capital expenditure (CAPEX) and converts infrastructure into predictable operating expense (OPEX), with immediate scalability and zero over-provisioning.
products.pain_solved: Eliminates the rigidity of fixed on-premise infrastructure that prevents rapid scaling in response to demand spikes or new digital initiatives.

products.name: HPE Aruba Networking CX Series
products.description: Enterprise network switch family supporting 1GbE, 10GbE, and 25GbE with an open networking design powered by AOS-CX for intelligent automation. Ideal for modern data centers, campus environments, and edge deployments requiring high availability and zero-touch provisioning.
products.roi_pitch: Reduces network configuration time by up to 90% through AOS-CX intelligent automation, minimizing human error and freeing IT teams to focus on strategic business initiatives.
products.pain_solved: Resolves slow, complex-to-manage networks with high reliance on manual configuration that introduce security vulnerabilities and slow incident response times.

products.name: HP EliteBook 840 G11
products.description: 14-inch enterprise laptop powered by Intel Core Ultra processors, MIL-SPEC durability certifications, 5G/LTE connectivity options, and integrated remote management with HP Wolf Security — the industry most comprehensive endpoint protection platform.
products.roi_pitch: Centrally managed endpoint fleet via HP Wolf Security Console, reducing IT support costs by up to 25% and extending device lifecycle while maintaining enterprise-grade security posture.
products.pain_solved: Replaces aging devices responsible for high support incident rates, reduced remote work productivity, and critical security risks from unsupported operating systems.

products.name: HPE Zerto Data Protection
products.description: Modern data protection platform with automated backup, disaster recovery (DR), and ransomware resilience. Compatible with virtual environments (VMware, Hyper-V), Kubernetes, and multicloud, delivering continuous data protection with near-zero RPO and RTO.
products.roi_pitch: Reduces recovery time objective (RTO) up to 4x versus traditional solutions, protecting business continuity and avoiding downtime losses that average $5,600 USD per minute in enterprise environments.
products.pain_solved: Eliminates vulnerability to ransomware attacks and critical data loss while ensuring compliance with data protection regulations including GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS.

products.name: HPE Aruba EdgeConnect SecOps
products.description: Enterprise perimeter security solution with industrial-grade VPN, 24/7 SOC monitoring, intrusion detection (IDS/IPS), and network segmentation for critical OT/IT environments. Purpose-built for industrial infrastructure, refineries, and manufacturing plants operating SCADA and legacy control systems.
products.roi_pitch: Reduces cybersecurity incident risk at industrial facilities by up to 80%, preventing losses that average $4.7M USD per attack in the energy and manufacturing sectors.
products.pain_solved: Protects critical OT/IT infrastructure at refineries and manufacturing plants against ransomware attacks, unauthorized access, and vulnerabilities in legacy SCADA control systems.

products.name: HPE ProLiant DL380 Gen11 AI Ready
products.description: 2U rack server purpose-built for AI, machine learning, and high-performance analytics workloads. Supports NVIDIA A100/H100 GPUs, high-speed NVMe storage, and InfiniBand connectivity for distributed compute clusters and large-scale model training.
products.roi_pitch: Accelerates time-to-insight up to 5x versus standard servers, reducing AI infrastructure costs by up to 60% compared to equivalent public cloud GPU instances.
products.pain_solved: Eliminates dependency on public cloud for sensitive AI workloads, keeping critical training data on-premise with superior performance, predictable cost, and zero data leakage risk.

products.name: HPE GreenLake for Storage
products.description: Enterprise Storage-as-a-Service (STaaS) with a flexible consumption model, automatic scalability, and unified management for multicloud and hybrid environments. Includes built-in deduplication, compression, and encryption delivered as a fully managed service on-premises.
products.roi_pitch: Converts storage spend from CAPEX to OPEX with an average 40% savings versus traditional procurement cycles, with immediate scalability and zero over-provisioning.
products.pain_solved: Eliminates storage over-provisioning and disruptive hardware refresh cycles every 3-5 years, delivering elastic capacity precisely aligned to actual business growth.
